original_query: select  min(i_item_id)  ,min(i_item_desc)  ,min(s_store_id)  ,min(s_store_name)  ,min(ss_net_profit)  ,min(sr_net_loss)  ,min(cs_net_profit)  ,min(ss_item_sk)  ,min(sr_ticket_number)  ,min(cs_order_number)  from  store_sales  ,store_returns  ,catalog_sales  ,date_dim d1  ,date_dim d2  ,date_dim d3  ,store  ,item  where  d1.d_moy = 6  and d1.d_year = 2002  and d1.d_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk  and i_item_sk = ss_item_sk  and s_store_sk = ss_store_sk  and ss_customer_sk = sr_customer_sk  and ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk  and ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number  and sr_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk  and d2.d_moy               between 6 and  6 + 2  and d2.d_year              = 2002  and sr_customer_sk = cs_bill_customer_sk  and sr_item_sk = cs_item_sk  and cs_sold_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk  and d3.d_moy               between 6 and  6 + 2  and d3.d_year              = 2002  ;
rewritten_query:
WITH date_jun_aug AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 2002
      AND d_moy BETWEEN 6 AND 8
)
SELECT
    MIN(i.i_item_id),
    MIN(i.i_item_desc),
    MIN(s.s_store_id),
    MIN(s.s_store_name),
    MIN(ss.ss_net_profit),
    MIN(sr.sr_net_loss),
    MIN(cs.cs_net_profit),
    MIN(ss.ss_item_sk),
    MIN(sr.sr_ticket_number),
    MIN(cs.cs_order_number)
FROM store_sales ss
JOIN store_returns sr
  ON ss.ss_customer_sk = sr.sr_customer_sk
 AND ss.ss_item_sk    = sr.sr_item_sk
 AND ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number
JOIN catalog_sales cs
  ON sr.sr_customer_sk = cs.cs_bill_customer_sk
 AND sr.sr_item_sk     = cs.cs_item_sk
JOIN date_dim d1
  ON d1.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
 AND d1.d_year    = 2002
 AND d1.d_moy     = 6
JOIN date_jun_aug d2
  ON d2.d_date_sk = sr.sr_returned_date_sk
JOIN date_jun_aug d3
  ON d3.d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
JOIN store s
  ON s.s_store_sk = ss.ss_store_sk
JOIN item i
  ON i.i_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk;

rewrite_suggestion.produced_suggestion: Replaced `d2.d_moy BETWEEN 6 AND 6+2` and `d3.d_moy BETWEEN 6 AND 6+2` with the folded constant `BETWEEN 6 AND 8` (optimizer folds this anyway, but it improves readability).

The shared Jun–Aug 2002 date filter (used by both d2 and d3) is centralized in one CTE (`date_jun_aug`), avoiding duplicated date filter logic while remaining inlinable; d1 is kept inline since it is a single-use, highly selective predicate.
Converted implicit comma joins into explicit ANSI JOINs, making the join graph unambiguous and reducing the risk of accidental Cartesian products. Semantic result set is unchanged.

Fact-to-fact joins (store_sales→store_returns→catalog_sales) are made explicit on the join keys; dimension joins (date_dim, store, item) are attached as equi-joins. Recommended supporting indexes: date_dim(d_year, d_moy, d_date_sk) and catalog_sales(cs_bill_customer_sk, cs_item_sk, cs_sold_date_sk) INCLUDE (cs_net_profit, cs_order_number).
The arithmetic expression `6 + 2` was pre-evaluated to `8` in the month range predicates.
